visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with an exterior view of a multi-story villa under bright daylight. The building features a grey stone textured facade on the lower level and white walls with glass balconies on the upper levels. A prominent green neon-style sign reads '500M'. Yellow and white captions appear at the top. (2) A transition to a private outdoor swimming pool area enclosed by a black fence and palm trees. Various inflatable toys, including a white unicorn and a large yellow duck, float on the clear blue water. Sunlight creates sharp reflections on the surface. (3) The camera moves indoors to a dedicated children's playroom. It features a modern curved slide made of wood and purple panels leading into a large pit filled with thousands of colorful plastic balls. The background shows painted mountain murals. (4) A close-up shot displays a multi-tier food stand filled with afternoon tea snacks including macarons, sandwiches, and small cakes. Behind it, shelves are stocked with various brands of cup noodles. (5) A series of fast-cut shots showcasing diverse guest rooms. One room features a Mediterranean blue and white staircase design; another has a warm wooden floor with a forest-themed mural and large plush toys on a sofa. Lighting is warm and bright throughout. (6) A girl in a plaid skirt is seen spinning happily in a modern bathroom with a glass-enclosed shower and a green plant wall. The camera pans to a communal living area where several adults are sitting on sofas and around a table, while children play in the background ball pit. (7) Outdoor activities are shown: a group of children feeds a large school of fish in a narrow pond next to the building. Two men are rowing an orange kayak along a calm waterway, captured from a eye-level perspective. (8) The final sequence shows a spacious living room with a large screen TV, a grey leather sofa, and professional-looking black Bose speakers mounted on the wall. The video concludes with a close-up of a golden 'Villa 500m' logo sign on a plant-covered wall.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy, fast-tempo electronic pop BGM characterized by a driving synthesizer beat. A male narrator introduces the villa with an enthusiastic, high-arousal voice in Traditional Chinese. A subtle 'whoosh' sound effect marks the visual transition from exterior to pool. (2) As the interior scenes play, the narrator's tone remains cheerful and informative, highlighting amenities. Faint background laughter and high-pitched vocalizations from children are audible, blending with the rhythmic music. A 'ding' SFX emphasizes the mention of the tea snacks. (3) During the outdoor activity sequence, the sound of water splashing and rhythmic thuds of rowing are mixed into the track. The narrator maintains a high speech rate without structural pauses. (4) The final phase features a slightly elevated music volume as the narrator gives the final recommendation. The BGM concludes with a short synthesized swell and a hard cut at the video's end.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Feature Showcase (Pool/Food/Rooms/Play) -> Activity Highlights -> CTA/Brand Reveal
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional travel vlog intended to showcase the extensive facilities and family-friendly environment of the 'Villa 500m' in Yilan. By highlighting diverse amenities like a ball pit, private pool, and outdoor kayaking alongside a variety of themed rooms, it appeals to large groups and families looking for a comprehensive vacation rental.
